cover.alt: A smiling young boy named Tenzing — also the photographer of this issue — wears a bright blue knit beanie layered over a sherpa-lined hood, and a transparent zip-up jacket covered in colourful Louis Vuitton-branded patches and smiley face graphics. He stands outdoors near water with mountains in the background. Warm, joyful, and documentary in feel. Cover line reads "Dreamchaser: Meet Tenzing, boy wonder and Dazed photographer."
